Ion Asset Management Ltd who had been investing in Mellanox Technologies Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $4.28 billion market cap company. (NASDAQ:MLNX) has risen 40.78% since May 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 29.23% the S&P500.
